name: Hanajima Yoma
source:
A sporty and energetic boy who dedicated himself to the field of sports. He has earned his title as the ace player of the basketball club, FudanShine. His dream is to win the Interschool Competition to be able to join the International Basketball Championship.

Yoma's standing creates a strong rivalry for the school's other popular sports club, the Fudan's Football Team. Being the ace himself makes him popular among the girls, as well as the fact that he's physically attractive.

What he doesn't know is that the football team captain, Moriyama Ryousuke, has set up something tragic to his streak of good reputation.

[Edited from in-game profile]
